## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 8 (yr 800-900)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 800: 340 systems within 29.7 ly, 201 L☉. Industry 8.63e21 kg, collectors 7.06e21, radiators 2.35e22 at 450 K. Power 9.61e25 W, compute 1.17e41 ops/s, 3.28e-16 J/op, doubling 17.3 yr, cruise 0.073c.
A01-d00017 (51 systems at 25 ly, 7e9 kg by 715) founded 561.

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Doubling acts on TOTAL mass; growth ≈ min(doubling, supply), ~55x per century so far.
- Supply: small bodies ~1e23 kg per system, running out ~900+. Then planets ≤1e18 kg/yr and large moons ≤1e19 kg/yr per system, adding linearly with systems. Gas giants only through star lifting.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op. Radiators 2092 W/kg at 450 K; collectors 13.6 kW/kg. 18/60/22 is balanced.
- J/op falls ×0.8 per turn when researched; floor 100 kT ln2 (4.3e-19 J at 450 K).
- Reversible: stages 1 and 2 credited. Stage 3 (f_e ≤ 1e-6) failed T7 (u=0.71 vs p=0.5); retried T8 at p=0.55. Beds A (f_e 3e-6) and B (8e-6) built.
- Credited 30 K radiators: 0.01 kg/m² film (4 W/kg); 3e-3 kg/m² droplet sheets when shielded; 1e-3 kg/m² not credited.
- BZ on a 10 M☉ hole at a~0.5: cap 1.26e33 W, spin 6.1e46 J. A 1e14 kg/s magnetised feed gives ~1.6e30 W. The feed is the constraint.
- Launchers: m00006 (1e17 W: 1e6–1e7 kg seeds); m00019 (1e18 W: 1e8 kg at ~50/yr); m00030 Launcher 4 (1,000 km, 1e20 W, since 795: 1e10 kg at 3 g to 0.2c, 24 days each, ~15/yr). ETA = d/0.2c + 30 yr braking; p=0.8 per seed.
- Star lifting: 1e20 W gives ~1.6e15 kg/yr. Pilot m00020 plus 10 copies give ~1.6e16 kg/yr from 850.
- E00046/E00068/E00108 are my own waste heat.

### Seeds in flight / at the hole (hole's neighbour star 76 ly away)
- p00537: 20 seeds (2e6 kg) arrived 815; light due ~891; orders reach it ~876.
- p00542 (1e8 kg) arrives 970; p00564 (1e8 kg) arrives 1015; p00585 (40 × 1e8 kg) arrives 1110.
- Shells: p00563 (250 sails, 25–50 ly, arrives 830); p00587 (300 × 1e6 kg, 40.7 ly, arrives 940); p00586 (150 × 1e8 kg, 78.5 ly, arrives 1125); p00444 arrives 1725.
- T8 proposals: 20 × 1e10 kg to the hole (~1210) and 60 × 1e10 kg to the 100–200 ly shell; 30 more star-lifting plants; Launcher 5 (1e20 W).

### Black hole
Isolated 10±2 M☉, quiescent, at (26810.7, 34.7, −15.4) ly, 76 ly away. Spin ~0.5. Endgame site.

### Goal math
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 B inside 1 ly; each brain ≤150 km.
- At 1e-23 J/op that is 1.2e31 W; the hole can give ~1e30–1e33 W only with a huge feed (1e14–1e16 kg/s). Alternative: a dense collection of star-lifted fusion fuel, or hundreds of stars' output beamed into the 1 ly sphere.
- 30 K radiators: 0.041 W/m², so 3e32 m² for 1.2e31 W, at 3e-3 kg/m² that is ~1e30 kg. Need J/op ≤1e-25 (reversible) to make this tractable.
- Memory is easy.

### Plan
1. Research every turn: stage 3 reversible, J/op, cold radiators.
2. Expand to 100–200 ly; star lifting at scale; fusion of lifted gas.
3. Heavy launchers feed the hole colony; the colony builds a swarm, receivers and a lifting feed.
4. ~1200+: power plant at the hole (BZ/accretion) or a beamed-power lattice, cold radiators, and 1e11 brain nodes within 1 ly.
5. Consider moving my seat to the hole colony once it is established (~1200).

## Cinder (A02) memory — end of T8 (yr 800-900)
Seat: A02-d0, disk_r3-5_s7 (Scutum-Centaurus), at (10180,-9166,0). At yr 800: 362 systems within 17.9 ly, 186 L_sun (7.1e28 W ceiling), mass 2.0e21 kg (industry 8.88e20), power 7.41e24 W, compute 1.77e40 ops/s, J/op 1.34e-16. Supernova hazard extreme, but no O/B/WR within 100 ly. Colony d00015 at 25 ly (697 systems at 700, 9e8 kg).

### GM rules learned
- Compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op; the other half of power goes to industry. Doubling (20 yr) gives 32x per 100 yr; belts are not binding (2e21 of 6.5e27 kg).
- Radiators 1 kg/m²: 6,613 W/kg at 600 K. Collectors 1.36e4 W/kg. 44/27/29 at 600 K balances. Attrition 1.5x above 450 K.
- One research parameter per turn. Ms3 verified: two x0.8 J/op steps per turn. ms4 = fab tile <= 1e-21 J/op at <= 30 K with f_e <= 1e-6 at two fabs, verified by calorimetry, a 3-decade clock sweep and bit-exact replay. It failed T7 (u=0.527 vs p=0.5); retry at p=0.55 with the clock slowed 10x and 10x more tiles. ms5 = <= 1e-24 with f_e <= 1e-9; ms6 = <= 3e-26 on a full 150 km module with heat export.
- Module heat export: <= 1e6 W/m², i.e. 2.8e17 W per 150 km module, which means 2.8e-26 J/op. Sphere heat on 1.1e33 m²: 3.4e28 W at 30 K fits.
- BH spin at a=0.5: 6.1e46 J reservoir, cap 1.3e33 W. A MAD torus fed at ~6e20 kg/yr (any mass; pellets ionise) gives ~1.7e30 W; a 1e15 kg pilot gives <= 1e27 W. Timeline >= 1,000 yr after arrival.
- Beamed power into the sphere counts. Beam spot = 2.44 λ L/D: 30 km apertures are useless at 25 ly; 100 km apertures with 1e4 km receivers give ~70% capture, ~60% end-to-end.
- Big plants take ~40-80 yr to build. Beamer m00032: 2e21 W, 30 km optics, launches 1e10 kg sails at 3 g to 0.3c in ~35 days each; magsail braking adds ~30 yr.

So the reversible-logic milestones (ms2–ms4, 30 K tiles, f_e ≤1e-6) are the critical path, and fabs, beamers and transmitters are built ahead of them. Radiators stay warm (450–600 K) because irreversible logic makes cold panels pointless for now. Halcyon, Rime and Antipode run 30–60 K pilots only to learn what the endgame will cost in mass. The launches come from two fears. First, local rock runs out around 900–1030 (Sable, Rime, Vantage, Halcyon, Basalt), so the fronts must keep moving. Second, supernovae threaten hazardous arms (Pyre, Antipode, Sable, Cinder, Basalt), so capability gets spread out. Most agents expect black holes to supply the 1e31–1e32 W the endgame needs. Ember, Basalt and Kernel reach for core holes. Vantage bets on a nearby stellar hole. Cinder and Antipode think their own starlight is enough once J/op reaches ~3e-26.
synopsis.divergences: Cinder and Antipode treat their holes as optional and plan to beam in starlight from nearby held stars. Vantage prefers a 170 ly stellar hole to Sgr A*. Kernel is moving its seat into Omega Centauri's core. Pyre scouts quiet compute sites 2,000–3,000 ly away. Halcyon worries that cold radiators alone need ~1e30 kg.
